data.content_ref: inline:The problem requires the deliverable to be a 'structured skeleton with explicit FORBIDDEN cases' for BOTH untested refusals, accompanied by provisional scratch-workshop notes (attack surface, fixture cost, false-green risk) linked together. SRC_001 provides only a single narrow claim about the lease-mismatch test (hardcoded-static-code mutation) and its counterconditions. It never composes the actual forbidden-case skeleton, omits the seat-binding refusal entirely, and presents no linked workshop notes. The claim targets a plausible mutation, but the artifact as a whole does not satisfy the required structural deliverable.
